title: Safari's Tab skips buttons: README and checklist
lede: No runtime code changes. In Safari, the owner found that Tab reached the Notes but not the toolbar. By default, Safari's Tab skips buttons and only reaches text fields and elements with `tabIndex={0}`, such as the Note's `<article>`. The README now says how to turn on full Tab navigation, and the cross-browser checklist gains the keyboard checks, including a Safari section.

steps.title: Tab reaches the Note but not its ×
steps.explain: With Safari's default setting, an element with an explicit `tabIndex={0}` is in the Tab order, and a `<button>` is not. This is Safari's documented default, not something checked in this session: Safari isn't in the test matrix.

steps.title: The README says how to reach every button
steps.explain: The code doesn't force buttons into Safari's Tab order. Keyboard users on a Mac usually have the setting on, and overriding it would go against their choice.
